title: Senior Data Scientist, Finance & Strategy
descriptionHtml:
About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to be the dedicated analytics partner to Chime’s Investor Relations and Corporate Strategy teams. As a public company, Chime reports its performance to the investor community every quarter, and that story has to rest on data that is accurate, consistent, and well understood. You’ll build a holistic view of how the business is performing, use internal data to help Chime communicate its progress through earnings and public disclosures, and bring analytical rigor to high-priority, high-visibility projects that shape Chime’s strategic direction.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll work with teams across Chime, from Finance and Product to Marketing, Risk, and Operations, to understand what drives performance in every part of the business and how to measure it. It is not an experimentation-focused role: the work centers on business performance, financial and operating metrics, and strategic analysis rather than A/B testing. You’ll thrive here if you pair a high bar for precision with the agility to move quickly as priorities shift.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Build a holistic, company-wide view of Chime’s performance, connecting member growth, engagement, and product usage to the financial and operating metrics that matter most to the business.
  • Partner with Investor Relations to turn internal data into how Chime communicates its progress to investors, supporting quarterly earnings materials, shareholder communications, and public disclosures.
  • Be an arbiter of truth with data, making sure the metrics Chime shares externally are precisely defined, consistent across sources, and able to withstand scrutiny.
  • Explain why metrics move. Spot trends and inflection points early, dig into the underlying drivers, and turn findings into clear narratives for senior leaders.
  • Partner with Corporate Strategy on high-priority, high-visibility projects with strategic impact for Chime, bringing structure and data to ambiguous, open-ended questions.
  • Work across every part of Chime, partnering with Finance, Product, Marketing, Risk, Operations, and other Analytics teams to understand how each area operates and how its performance should be measured.
  • Deliver high-stakes analyses on tight timelines, such as during earnings cycles, without compromising accuracy.
  • Build durable, reusable data models and reporting so recurring questions get answered consistently and efficiently.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work in data-focused roles delivering analyses for an executive audience.
  • Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, or a similar analytical role before moving into data (highly valued).
  • Strong financial acumen: fluency in financial statements, unit economics, and the KPIs investors use to evaluate business performance. Familiarity with public company reporting, earnings, and disclosures is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for accuracy. You reconcile numbers across sources, pressure-test your own work, and understand the stakes of getting it right.
  • Agility and comfort with ambiguity. You reprioritize quickly, perform well under tight deadlines, and bring structure to open-ended problems.
  • Expert-level SQL and proficiency in Python for analysis.
  • Strong business intuition and the ability to think holistically about how a company creates value (FinTech or financial services experience a plus).
  • Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with experience distilling complex analyses into clear, concise narratives for senior leaders. Experience with Hex is a plus.
  • A track record of building trusted relationships and working cross-functionally with many teams at once.
  • Experience building data models in dbt, and fluency with AI coding and analytics tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).

title: Business Control Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are hiring a Business Control Manager to join Chime's Compliance Business Control Management team. You will own the control strategy, business relationships, and results for the Membership, App and AI Experience, and Trust and Safety portfolios. Working with the Enterprise BCM Lead and business partners, you will translate new initiatives, existing business activities, regulatory requirements, incidents, and other changes into clear control outcomes and practical plans.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who can move comfortably between strategy and delivery. You will assess current control coverage, lead material control decisions and implementation work within your portfolios, and ensure controls are validated, documented, and maintained. Business and control owners remain responsible for implementing and operating their controls; you will provide the structure, challenge, and partnership needed to produce durable results.

You will also contribute across the Enterprise BCM team by supporting Enterprise work when priorities and capacity require it, and by helping identify shared exposure themes and common control approaches across portfolios.

In This Role You Can Expect To

  • Own the control strategy and coverage view for assigned portfolios, using business activities, regulatory requirements, existing controls, gaps, and dependencies to set priorities.
  • Evaluate new initiatives and the existing environment through reviews of process or product changes, incidents, complaints, findings, and current control practices. Determine whether controls should be reused, enhanced, created, consolidated, or retired.
  • Lead control design and implementation with business and control owners, establishing clear objectives, scope, ownership, evidence, exception handling, delivery plans, and closure criteria while keeping control ownership and operation with the business.
  • Assess control readiness, coordinate owner attestations, and determine whether controls meet the agreed validation criteria. Arrange an independent reviewer when your involvement in implementation requires additional separation.
  • Lead control responses to incidents, issues, complaints, and findings by connecting root causes to control gaps, establishing remediation expectations, and confirming affected controls are revalidated before closure.
  • Maintain reliable control records and use coverage, implementation, validation, and exception data to identify recurring themes, recommend shared approaches, and communicate results and remaining exposure to leadership.
  • Build strong relationships across business, product, engineering, operations, legal, compliance, risk, and data teams, and support bank partner reviews, audits, examinations, and other assurance activities.

To Thrive in This Role You Have

  • 7 or more years of experience in business controls, regulatory compliance, operational risk, audit, or a related discipline within financial services, fintech, or another highly regulated environment.
  • Experience independently owning a complex portfolio or control environment, setting priorities, leading cross-functional decisions, and moving work from assessment through validated and documented closure.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate business activities and control coverage, distinguish control gaps from documentation or mapping gaps, and develop practical responses.
  • Hands-on experience designing or enhancing controls with business, product, engineering, operations, or data teams and defining the evidence needed to demonstrate that controls operate as designed.
  • Sound knowledge of consumer financial protection and regulatory risk, including EFTA and Regulation E, TILA and Regulation Z, UDAAP, or comparable frameworks.
  • Strong judgment, influence, and communication skills, including the ability to challenge senior partners constructively, work through competing priorities, translate complex requirements, and identify when leadership escalation is needed.
  • Strong execution and organization skills, including managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, decisions, exceptions, and control records within a GRC platform or comparable system of record.

descriptionHtml:
About the role

Chime Enterprise, the business-to-business division of Chime that partners with employers to provide workplace financial wellness benefits, is looking for a Director of Communications & Content to own the Chime Enterprise narrative.

In this role, you will oversee external press, internal communications, executive visibility, and thought leadership, including the editorial, social, and creator programs that support Chime Enterprise.

You’ll manage a small team of B2B content writers, as well as our PR agency of record. A core part of this role is making sure the story we tell the press, the story we tell through our own channels, and the story we tell through social and creator voices all work together.

You’ll report directly to the Head of Marketing & Growth, Chime Enterprise, and partner closely with peers across Demand Generation, Creative, Internal Communications, and External Communications.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Set and execute our external communications strategy, including media relations, press strategy, and share-of-voice goals for the Enterprise business.
  • Build and maintain relationships with tier-one and trade media, analysts, and industry influencers relevant to our category.
  • Identify, develop, and place executive thought leadership, including bylines, speaking opportunities, podcasts, and media appearances. Serve as a strategic partner to company spokespeople.
  • Manage our PR agency of record. Set the brief, hold the agency accountable to measurable outcomes, and determine when work is best handled internally or externally.
  • Ensure consistency across press messaging, executive thought leadership, owned content, social, and creator programs so that each channel reinforces the same core narrative.
  • Help drive internal communications for the Enterprise business. Ensure internal and external communications are coordinated and sequenced appropriately.
  • Build and manage an HR and payroll analyst relations program that keeps key analysts informed and engaged, while partnering with them on larger programs when appropriate.
  • Lead the Chime Enterprise executive thought leadership program, ensuring our executive voices are differentiated and support our commercial goals.
  • Set the direction and quality bar for long-form and editorial content, including blogs, guides, ebooks, and other thought leadership.
  • Oversee our organic social and influencer/creator programs.
  • Work closely with cross-functional partners across Investor Relations, Government Affairs and Public Policy, Legal, and Compliance.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in communications or PR, including at least 3 years in a people-management or agency-management role.
  • A Player-coach: You can set the strategy, lead a team, and roll up your sleeves to get the work done. You’re always looking for ways to make the work better and the team more effective.
  • Experience working in a high-growth startup environment and managing multiple priorities at once with urgency.
  • Proficiency with AI tools and an ability to use them to improve the quality and speed of content development.
  • A track record of securing meaningful press coverage and building executive visibility, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, HR tech, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience turning first-party or third-party data into compelling stories that can earn tier-one media coverage.
  • Experience managing an outside PR agency from the client side.
  • Comfort serving as a strategic partner and occasional ghostwriter for senior executives.
  • Experience working with content, social, or community teams. You do not need to have directly managed each of these functions, but you should understand how they work and be able to set a high bar for quality.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with creator or influencer programs as an earned-media channel.
  • Experience supporting investor communications, including earnings announcements, and/or Government Affairs and public policy communications.
  • Both in-house and agency-side experience.

title: Staff Data Scientist, Marketing Analytics
descriptionHtml:
About the role

When people sign up for Chime, we want to know which marketing efforts brought them in and which ones brought in members who stay and use their account. You will set the direction for how Chime answers that question.

You will be the senior analytics leader for paid marketing. You will co-own and help decide how we measure a 9 figure plus paid media budget and how that measurement turns into optimization and allocation decisions. This is a high-visibility role. Marketing, Growth, Finance and executive leaders will treat your work as the main reference for how marketing performs. You will join the Marketing Analytics team and work across Marketing, Finance, Data Engineering and Data Science/ML.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Own the paid performance story. Track spend and results across channels every week. Explain why numbers moved, in plain words that a non-analyst can act on.
  • Measure new-member offers. Show whether our introductory new member offers bring in better members and whether they are worth the cost. Compare offer groups against fair, matched groups.
  • Set the bar for experiments and offers. Define how tests are designed and read, and how we decide whether sign-up offers are worth the cost.
  • Improve how we credit marketing channels. Find where our attribution rules fall short, propose better ones, and work with Data Engineering to build and maintain them.
  • Turn marketing mix modeling into budget advice. Use the output of our Marketing Mix Model to advise Marketing on how to allocate budget across channels.
  • Be a proactive business partner. Work with Marketing, Growth and Finance leaders as a trusted partner. Share insights and recommendations before they ask, and help them decide what to do next.
  • Help plan the work ahead. Estimate the likely impact of new marketing ideas so the team can prioritize.
  • Use AI to work faster and go deeper. Use AI tools to speed up analysis, check your work, and build things others can reuse.
  • Raise the level of the team. Coach senior data scientists, guide contractors and set the quality bar for high-stakes work.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • A Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience in analytics or data science, with deep experience in marketing, growth or consumer products
  • A track record of setting measurement strategy across several teams, not only delivering analyses within one team
  • Deep expertise in marketing measurement: attribution, incrementality, MMM, cost per acquisition and LTV:CAC, including designing these systems from scratch
  • Expert-level experimentation and causal inference skills, including knowing when standard methods don’t fit and building approaches that do
  • Strong SQL and experience shaping data models and pipelines in large data warehouses (we use Snowflake)
  • Advanced Python or a similar language for analysis
  • Experience using Marketing Mix Model output to guide budget decisions at significant scale
  • Hands-on experience bringing AI tools into analytics work for a team, and good judgment about their limits
  • A history of influencing VP-level and executive decisions without formal authority, including settling disagreements between competing stakeholders
  • Clear writing and speaking for senior, non-technical audiences
  • A track record of growing other senior data scientists’ skills through mentorship, frameworks and shared tools
  • Comfort with problems that have no precedent, where you have to define both the question and the approach

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the role

We're hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Lifecycle & CRM Marketing team. In this role, you'll build and optimize campaigns that engage, retain, and grow Chime members across their lifecycle — from acquisition through long-term retention — with a focus on member experience, revenue, and LTV.

This is a role for a hands-on marketer who thinks beyond the send. You'll work across email, push, in-app, and SMS, building campaigns grounded in member behavior and lifecycle signals. You'll partner with data, analytics, and cross-functional teams on segmentation, experimentation, and personalization — and you bring genuine enthusiasm for how AI tools are changing what's possible in lifecycle marketing.

This is a growth role for someone early in their career who has already shown they can execute and is hungry to build toward strategy. You move fast, ask good questions, and care about the member experience in everything you do.

If you're curious, driven, and love working in a fast-paced environment alongside people who care about the product and the member, we want to meet you.

What you'll do

  • Build and manage lifecycle campaigns across email, push, in-app, and SMS — from brief through launch and measurement
  • Think in journeys, not just individual sends — you'll map member flows based on what they do, where they are in their lifecycle, and what they need next
  • Develop audience segments that go beyond demographics and reflect where members actually are in their relationship with Chime
  • Run experiments and come back with a clear point of view on what worked, what didn't, and what to do next
  • Work closely with data and analytics partners to understand campaign performance and what member behavior is telling us
  • Use AI tools in your day-to-day — for drafting, content variation, personalization logic, or finding efficiencies. 
  • Respect and apply channel best practices and consider channel health in building your strategy and programming: deliverability, frequency, compliance, and the overall member experience
  • Collaborate and build strong cross-functional relationships with creative, product, and other stakeholders to align on goals and get campaigns out the door

What we're looking for

  • 2–4 years in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing with real campaign execution experience across at least one channel (email, push, in-app, or SMS)
  • Hands-on experience with a marketing automation or CRM platform — Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, or something similar
  • Detail-oriented: quality of output is important to you and you understand how it affects the member experience
  • Comfortable with data — you can read a dashboard, pull your own numbers, and figure out what the story is
  • You use AI tools and have real enthusiasm for them; you've formed opinions from experimenting, not just reading about it
  • Strong instincts about what makes a good (or bad) member experience, and you speak up about it
  • Clear written and verbal communication — you can translate strategy into execution and results into a coherent point of view
  • You move fast, you're curious, and you pick things up quickly

This role partners closely with cross-functional leaders across Marketing, Growth, Product, and Data to manage marketing budget, evaluate growth initiatives, measure performance, and inform strategic investment decisions. title: Director, Growth Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Growth is how millions of people find Chime, set up direct deposit, transact every day, unlock all the features and benefits Chime offers, and keep coming back. The Growth Platform is the engine behind it: Web, Paid, Notifications, Incentives, Targeting, Experimentation and Personalization, all used by every Growth team at Chime. We're looking for a Director to lead this org and build what comes next, a platform where AI and ML decide what each member sees, when, and on which channel, and where AI agents design, run and learn from experiments on their own, so Chime learns faster every week. If you've built growth platforms at scale and want to define how they power Chime's hypergrowth in 2027 and beyond, we'd love to talk.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Lead the Growth Platform org, a team of tech lead managers (TLMs) and senior engineers across Web, Paid, Notifications, Incentives, Targeting, Experimentation and Personalization. You'll report to the VP of Growth Engineering.
  • Set the multi-year vision and roadmap. Turn seven separate systems into one connected growth platform with shared member data, decisioning and measurement.
  • Make the platform AI-native and agentic. Put ML and GenAI to work in targeting, bidding, content, incentives and send-time optimization. Invest in agentic flows across the platform, starting with self-learning experiment agents that generate hypotheses, launch and monitor tests, read results, and feed what they learn into the next round. Build in the evaluation, guardrails and human oversight to make this safe.
  • Help Growth teams ship faster. Make it easy for squads, marketers and partners to launch, target, personalize and measure changes on their own, in days rather than weeks.
  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Data Science/ML and Analytics leaders. You'll co-own the plan, make trade-offs openly, and tie platform bets to the metrics that matter: new direct depositors, retention and acquisition efficiency.
  • Hire, coach and grow strong tech lead managers who stay hands-on technically while leading their teams. Build an inclusive, high-ownership team people want to join and stay on.
  • Keep the platforms reliable, cost-efficient and compliant. Work with Risk, Compliance and Privacy so consent, fairness and member trust are built in from day one.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years leading teams and at least 2 years leading tech lead managers or other leaders. You know how to help TLMs balance technical ownership with people leadership.
  • A track record of building growth or marketing platforms that many teams rely on, such as experimentation, targeting, messaging, incentives/rewards, paid attribution or personalization.
  • Hands-on experience shipping ML-powered systems that make real-time product decisions (ranking, propensity/uplift models, bandits or similar), plus experience building LLM-based agents or agentic workflows in production, with a practical view of how to evaluate, govern and scale them.
  • Deep experimentation and measurement chops. You know how to prove a lift is real, and how to build platforms that keep tests trustworthy at high volume.
  • Strong distributed systems and data architecture judgment: real-time event pipelines, feature stores, low-latency decisioning and high-volume messaging.
  • Clear executive communication and a history of earning buy-in across Product, Marketing and Data Science.
  • Bonus: experience in fintech or another regulated industry, paid acquisition/mobile measurement, or leading a large platform migration.

title: Manager, Corporate Finance
descriptionHtml:
About the role

We’re seeking a Manager to join the Corporate Finance team at Chime! In this role, you’ll play a central part in one of the company’s most important priorities: preparing Chime’s finance organization to integrate a recent acquisition. You’ll serve as Corporate Finance’s lead on integration readiness, partnering cross-functionally with FP&A, Accounting, Data, and Systems teams to align processes, reporting, planning models, and forecasts ahead of close, then own pro forma views and combined company KPI tracking post-close. You’ll also be a hands-on partner across a lean Corporate Finance team, supporting public company workstreams and using AI tools to build automation and dashboards that make our work faster and more scalable.

We’re looking for a highly organized, analytical, and collaborative finance leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, drive cross-functional workstreams to completion, and translate complex financial detail into clear insights for senior leadership.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Lead Corporate Finance’s workstream for the integration of a recent acquisition, building and tracking the Day 1 readiness plan (close calendar, chart of accounts, reporting cutover), milestones, and dependencies through close and into post-close
  • Partner cross-functionally with FP&A, Accounting, Data, and Systems teams to align on account mapping, reporting hierarchies, data flows, and planning models (Pigment) for the combined company
  • Build pro forma and combined-company 3 statement financial views and combined KPI tracking, and incorporate the acquired business into the monthly forecast, annual operating plan, and long-range model 
  • Identify integration risks, gaps, and open decisions early; drive issues to resolution and provide clear, concise status updates to Finance leadership
  • Central point of contact on finance-wide communications and updates related to integration 
  • Identify and track forecasted cost and organizational synergies that have been previously identified and sized
  • Report out on measures of success related to integration progress and develop dashboards to track milestones
  • Serve as a flexible partner across the Corporate Finance team, supporting ad hoc analyses and strategic projects 
  • Leverage AI tools to automate manual processes, build dashboards, and increase efficiency across Corporate Finance 

To thrive in this role, you have

  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience in FP&A, corporate or strategic finance, investment banking, corporate development, or consulting; public company experience and/or M&A integration experience strongly preferred
  • Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent degree in Business, Finance, Accounting or relevant field; MBA or CPA a plus
  • Strong understanding of the three financial statements and public company reporting, including the quarterly earnings cycle
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects with many stakeholders and firm deadlines
  • Expertise in Excel / Google Sheets - you can build scalable, efficient, and intuitive models with ease; experience with Pigment, SQL, BI/dashboarding tools, or AI LLMs is a plus
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the judgment to deliver accurate, executive-ready materials under tight timelines
  • Superior communication skills and the ability to influence and collaborate with all levels of an organization, including senior leadership
  • A team-oriented, builder mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity

title: Sr. Analyst, Identity & KYC
descriptionHtml:
About the role 

The Financial Crimes Senior Analyst is responsible for the oversight of KYC and watchlist screening operations, including OFAC, to identify false positives and positive matches.  

In this role, you can expect to

  • Oversees investigators who leverage data to confirm positive matches or false positives
  • Reaches out to customers to understand customer behavior and to obtain any additional details pertinent to evaluating activities under review, if needed.
  • Makes a determination whether the match is a true positive.
  • In depth subject matter expertise for list screening, watchlist, and OFAC.
  • Experience and/or familiarity with Transaction Monitoring and/or Fraud reviews is preferred.
  • Performs other job related duties or special projects as assigned.
  • Assist with dispositioning cases according to agreed upon business Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Recommend relationship retention or termination and track account closures, if required

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 5+ years banking, risk management, or fraud detection/investigation experience.
  • CAMS certification is a plus
  • Prior experience with Fraud and/or AML investigations, with a preference for both, including the ability to identify potentially unusual activity
  • Practical experience managing audits, independent reviews, or examinations by bank partners or regulators, including the resolution of identified issues
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to multi-task, maintain accuracy, and meet deadlines in a fast paced, high volume environment.
  • Effective analytical and problem solving skills, with abilities in analyzing data patterns and investigating customer transactions.
  • Self starter possessing the ability to work independently while supporting a team environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and high concern for data accuracy with the ability to follow directions and apply proper policies, procedures and guidelines.
  • Knowledgeable of the laws applicable to money laundering, including the Bank Secrecy Act, the USA PATRIOT act, US Treasury AML guidelines, OFAC requirements, and Unusual/Suspicious Activity Reporting requirements preferred
  • Proficiency with, or ability to quickly gain proficiency with, banking account monitoring and compliance software tools, Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word).
  • Aptitude and/or curiosity toward adoption of AI tooling is preferred.

title: Content Marketing Manager, SEO & AI Search
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

People increasingly find financial products by asking ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode instead of scrolling search results. Chime's Organic Growth team helps members find Chime without paid media. Chime is already one of the most visible brands in AI answers in several core banking categories, and we want to widen that lead.

We're hiring a Content Marketing Manager, SEO & AI Search to own the content and citation work that wins in AI search. You'll run Chime's blog from planning through publishing, run our AI-powered content workflows, and earn Chime coverage on the third-party sources AI models trust most. You'll partner closely with our Principal, AI Search Strategy & SEO, who sets Chime's AI search strategy, priority categories, targets, and measurement. You'll own the content that helps us hit those Visibility targets.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of room for strategy. In the same week you might find a citation gap in a high-value category, brief a publisher partner, move a refreshed article through compliance review, and publish it in our CMS.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Own Chime's blog and editorial content plan for SEO and AEO. You'll turn priority categories, prompt data, and member insights into a sequenced roadmap that helps Chime own its story and earn accurate, positive citations in AI answers.

title: Senior Operations Manager, Partner Management
descriptionHtml:
About the role

This is a high-visibility opportunity to own the health, evolution, and strategic value of a member operations ecosystem at Chime's only onshore customer operations center.

You will lead as one part Operator (running the operations with rigor), one part Strategist (improving the operations by challenging what exists), and one part Influencer (informing the business by turning frontline signals into company decisions). The role carries real executive presence: you'll be the person in the room translating what's happening on the frontline into decisions senior leaders act on. This is an on-site role (location TBD -  Austin, San Antonio) — you'll be embedded with the operation you own, not managing it from a distance, and you'll serve as a cultural ambassador for Chime within the partnership (BPO) and a highly effective motivator of front line staff. You will play a hands-on role in daily partner governance, business reviews, escalation management, and operational initiatives that improve frontline execution and member outcomes.

In this role, you can expect to

Run the Operations

  • Own performance governance for assigned Partner/BPO operations, including SLAs, quality, productivity, staffing adherence, operational efficiency, and member experience outcomes.
  • Lead daily, weekly, and monthly partner performance reviews with clear metrics, action plans, owners, timelines, and expected business impact.
  • Drive accountability with external partners by identifying performance gaps, aligning on corrective actions, and ensuring sustained follow-through.

Improve the Operations

  • Challenge existing processes, technology, staffing models, and site/channel strategy rather than optimizing within them.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve member and service experience, from problem definition and stakeholder alignment through execution, change management, and post-launch measurement.
  • Identify automation and AI opportunities within the partner operation, and help redesign the operating model as routine volume shifts to AI Agents.

Influence the Business 

  • Operate with a level of entrepreneurship and ownership consistent with running a business unit, not administering a contract.
  • Translate operational performance trends into root-cause insights, risk assessments, and data-backed recommendations.
  • Develop concise, executive-ready updates that connect frontline performance, member impact, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended next steps — with a point of view.

Build the Chime Culture Onsite

  • Establish and sustain a shared Chime culture in our onshore BPO partner location.
  • Partner with Chime and BPO leaders to translate Chime’s values—including member obsession and financial peace of mind—into observable behaviors, coaching expectations, hiring standards, and recognition programs.
  • Own and measure cultural health through indicators such as leadership visibility, employee engagement, attrition, coaching quality, product fluency, member sentiment, and frontline feedback closure.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 10+ years of experience in leading on site Customer Experience operations, Partner/Vendor Management, BPO operations, or a related operational leadership role, ideally within financial services or another highly regulated environment.
  • Executive presence and sound business judgment - comfortable building trust and influencing decisions — including with senior stakeholders — combined with high ownership and comfort operating autonomously in ambiguity.
  • Strong analytical skills - demonstrated ability to identify trends, diagnose root causes, assess risks, and build clear, actionable recommendations — own partner performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge the status quo — a track record of redesigning a process, system, or operating model — paired with the influence, relationship-building, and communication skills to drive alignment and accountability without direct authority.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Excel, Google Sheets/Slides, Looker, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Onsite presence required at least 5 days a week 
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

title: Sr. CRM Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the role

We're hiring a Sr. CRM Operations Manager to help transform how Chime's Lifecycle Marketing & CRM team operates and scales. You'll lead our most important cross-functional CRM initiatives, connecting Lifecycle Marketing, MarTech, Engineering, and other partners to turn complex business needs into scalable systems and processes. As a strategic individual contributor, you'll influence technical roadmaps, improve operational efficiency, and help us build smarter, more automated member experiences. This isn't a daily campaign execution or engineering role—your impact will come from bringing teams together, solving complex operational challenges, and building systems that help us move faster.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Lead high-impact CRM initiatives: Own complex, cross-functional programs such as platform migrations, channel integrations, and automation transformations—from early discovery through implementation and adoption.
  • Connect Marketing with Product and Engineering: Translate lifecycle marketing goals into clear business requirements, data specifications, and technical priorities, helping teams align on what needs to be built and why.
  • Make CRM operations more scalable: Improve campaign intake, QA standards, documentation, governance, and prioritization processes so teams can execute more efficiently and with fewer errors.
  • Strengthen channel health and compliance: Partner with Legal, Compliance, Data, and channel owners to improve deliverability, consent management, frequency capping, and messaging quality.
  • Drive the evolution of lifecycle automation: Help move our CRM ecosystem beyond manual, campaign-focused workflows toward automated, scalable, and intelligent member journeys.
  • Influence teams and priorities: Work closely with senior stakeholders to resolve dependencies, navigate competing priorities, and drive decisions without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Deliver measurable operational impact: Establish success metrics and connect improvements in workflows, systems, and governance to efficiency, execution quality, risk reduction, and downstream business outcomes.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 8+ years of experience in CRM operations, marketing program management, or marketing technology alignment, with a track record of working in complex marketing environments.
  • Demonstrated ownership of large cross-functional initiatives, taking ambiguous business problems through planning, implementation, stakeholder alignment, and successful adoption.
  • Strong business-to-technical translation skills, including experience turning marketing needs into actionable requirements for Product, Engineering, and data teams.
  • Deep familiarity with enterprise CRM platforms such as Braze, Iterable, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including how data infrastructure supports lifecycle marketing capabilities.
  • Experience building scalable operating frameworks, including campaign intake, operational governance, quality assurance, and documentation standards.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve competing priorities, and drive decisions without direct authority.
